'''Hirken''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] and a member of the [[Hirken family]] who fought for the side of [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] in the [[Fifth Alsakan Conflict]]. He was remembered for his [[Admiral Hirken's campaign in the Northern Dependencies|tenacious defense]] of Alsakani colonies in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] in [[12,980 BBY]], which ultimately decided the war.
